How do you feel about who to blame for the Ukraine conflict?

I spoke to a Russian friend of mine about this... he studies law in Zurich and he sounded very convinced that Russia had every right to take action. The picture he painted was very different from the one I've seen in western media. Granted, he had no way to provide any substance to the claims he made, but I have to say I was fascinated to see him talk about this topic with so much, I guess we can call it passion. After that talk, I am undecided about this conflict and without doing my own research, I am not taking any sides.

The truth I have arrived at is that it is practically impossible for me to find out what the truth actually is. The only thing I am certain of is that the story, as presented by most of the western media in unison, is not the truth. And this has nothing to do with conspiracy theories, all evidence required for this claim is an intense look at how newspapers today blindly report press statements of western governments as facts. Press statements are, by definition, PR, which again is the trendy version of propaganda. I have barely seen any investigative journalism on the topic, the utmost majority so far has been copypasted state PR.

So yeah, I am not cynical or sarcastic when I say that I am absolutely certain that there is no truth to be found in the larger western news media. And no, that doesn't make russian propaganda true, in case anyone wanted to suggest that.
